verdict.is_civique_top_of_market: PARTIAL — Civique is top on platform breadth, languages, SRS rigor, and design narrative, but is materially behind on AI features, marketing claims (announced question count), social proof numbers, SEO content footprint, and onboarding/conversion (checklist dossier). verdict.headline: Civique is top-tier on architecture and language coverage, but not 'leader' on the market-facing comparison axes prospects evaluate. The two strongest competitors — LeTestCivique and ExamenCiviqueNaturalisation — both ship AI features Civique doesn't have. The market is consolidating around one-time pack pricing (we're an outlier with subscription) and AI-augmented prep (we're behind). Civique can credibly claim 'most international (8 languages), only true SRS, only with native apps' but can NOT yet claim 'most complete product'.
